businesses.business: cloud supply chain EDI and retail analytics software

offering_description.value: Provides a cloud-based supply chain management platform that connects retailers, suppliers, distributors and logistics firms for electronic data interchange (EDI) order and invoice exchange. Also sells fulfillment, item setup, analytics and assortment tools, delivered as subscription software to trading partners.

primary_products.value: cloud EDI software; supply chain fulfillment software; retail analytics software; item and assortment management software

primary_services.value: managed EDI services; supplier onboarding and support; data integration services

customer_segment.value: B2B: retailers, suppliers, manufacturers, distributors and logistics firms exchanging orders and invoices

end_markets.value: retail; consumer goods; grocery; apparel; distribution and logistics

revenue_model.value: subscription: recurring cloud platform fees from suppliers and retailers; service fees: onboarding, managed services and support

value_chain_position.value: software / platform: operates cloud network linking retailers and suppliers, sold to trading partners

geography_served.value: global: North America headquartered, with customers across Europe, Asia-Pacific and Latin America

specialization.value: related lines: EDI, fulfillment, analytics and item management on one supply chain cloud platform

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: sales team selling to suppliers and retailers; partners / resellers: retailer-driven supplier programs and technology partners

regulatory_exposure.value: low: normal business rules plus data privacy and security standards
